instruction: A clearing deep in an enchanted forest: a mossy stone wishing well glowing softly from within, a colossal ancient oak with a door in its trunk, a ring of red-capped toadstools, drifting fairy lights, luminous flowers, a curious deer at the clearing edge, fireflies, and moonbeams filtering through the canopy onto the well.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Enchanted Forest Well. A clearing deep in an enchanted forest: a mossy stone wishing well glowing softly from within, a colossal ancient oak with a door in its trunk, a ring of red-capped toadstools, drifting fairy lights, luminous flowers, a curious deer at the clearing edge, fireflies, and moonbeams filtering through the canopy onto the well. Style: fairytale glow. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
